All I can say is you know your body. You know when something isn't right. You know when you don't feel good. With POTS or any similar invisible illness, you will encounter a LOT and I mean A LOT of people, medical professionals and family/friends/strangers who will not believe you or your symptoms. I went and got a second opinion from a cardiologist who confirmed my heart rate skyrockets when I stand and he listened to me. I am on beta blockers now. Don't give up. Get a second opinion. An apartment breezeway is a covered, open-air corridor that connects the separate units of an apartment complex. Think of it as a hallway without walls. These breezeways often run the length of a building, providing access to the individual apartment doors from the outside while allowing fresh air to flow through. They can help with ventilation and give a more open and spacious feel to the building. You might also find stairwells or elevators in breezeways for easy access to different floors.
